primitives.name: Injury Removal Protocol

primitives.assumptions: Instantaneous detection of performance degradation, binary decision logic for removal.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( S_{stun} > S_{critical} \) or \( v_{current} < v_{threshold} \)

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's emergency state handler which triggers immediate player substitution upon detecting unsafe motion dynamics.
layer2.telemetry: Player motion vector deviation, reaction time, cognitive function score
